summary: Tested AI credit estimate badges + >15cr confirm-gate wiring across all 5 EG screens. Found and fixed ONE CRITICAL bug: eg-session.tsx referenced useAiEstimate + confirmAiSpend on lines 21/45 without importing them, which would have produced a ReferenceError red-screen the moment the screen mounted. Added the missing import — page now renders cleanly. Verified GET /api/ai-wallet/estimates returns the correct map (eg_trap_analyze=9, eg_loop_recommend=7, eg_loop_reframe=10, eg_limitation_classify=7, eg_limitation_reframe=10, eg_aim_analyze=14, eg_breakthrough_report=20, confirm_threshold_credits=15) end-to-end (curl + in-browser fetch). Code-level inspection of eg-trap/eg-loop/eg-limitation/eg-aim confirms each AI button label interpolates `~${est} cr` and gates the call behind confirmAiSpend with the matching feature key. eg-session.tsx is the only screen with cost > 15cr (20cr) and is the only one whose confirmAiSpend will actually pop the Alert.alert dialog (others short-circuit to true since <=15). Note (minor): React Native Alert.alert on react-native-web is polyfilled — on the WEB preview the confirm dialog manifests as a browser confirm()/no-op rather than a native modal, but on iOS/Android it works as expected. The estimate-fetch cache + per-button label rendering is web-safe.
action_items: (FYI only) Main agent — I already patched eg-session.tsx to add the missing `import { confirmAiSpend, useAiEstimate } from '../../src/utils/aiEstimates';`. Please keep this import in any future refactor of that screen.

(Optional polish) Consider explicitly testing the >15cr confirm dialog on a native build (Expo Go / device). On react-native-web the Alert.alert polyfill behaves differently than native — the per-action gating logic still works, but the visual modal is browser-style.
critical_code_review_comments: eg-session.tsx was using useAiEstimate('eg_breakthrough_report') + confirmAiSpend(...) without importing them — would have crashed the screen with ReferenceError. FIXED.

All 5 EG screens now share the same pattern: const xEst = useAiEstimate('feature_key'); button label = `Action${xEst ? ` · ~${xEst} cr` : ''}`; AI call gated by `if (!(await confirmAiSpend('feature_key', 'Label'))) return;`. Consistent and correct.
Backend /api/ai-wallet/estimates correctly derives credits from FEATURE_TOKENS / tokens_per_credit (e.g. 900/100=9 for eg_trap_analyze) and exposes confirm_threshold_credits=15.

rca_of_issue: RCA — eg-session.tsx red-screen risk: PRD called for useAiEstimate('eg_breakthrough_report') + confirmAiSpend('eg_breakthrough_report', ...) on the session screen. Hooks/functions were used (lines 21 + 45) but no `import { confirmAiSpend, useAiEstimate } from '../../src/utils/aiEstimates';` statement was added — likely lost when the prior agent fixed the 'corrupted trailing line' mentioned in the handoff note.
